world_org_meetings.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
world_org_meetings.description: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
world_org_meetings.description: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: The new lines of southern Lebanon
world_org_meetings.description: The U.N. expanded the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon's mandate 20 years ago to include monitoring adherence to a ceasefire in fighting between Israel and Lebanon's Iran-backed Hezbollah — the militant group created in 1982 to counter a second Israeli invasion.

world_org_meetings.title: Head of European Investment Bank eyes Canada opportunities as Carney pushes EU ties
world_org_meetings.description: The president of the European Union's investment bank says "the time is ripe" to deepen its co-operation with Canada by exploring how to finance Canadian projects — comments that come as Prime Minister Mark Carney pushes for more EU ties.

world_org_meetings.title: North Korea fires two ballistic missiles off east coast in three hours
world_org_meetings.description: North Korea launched two missiles off its eastern coast on Sunday, its second set of tests in roughly a week and days after Pyongyang accused the U.S. of driving tensions on the Korean Peninsula through a series of military drills.

diplomatic_visits.title: Defining global leadership in AI at Trump-Xi summit
diplomatic_visits.description: Former U.S. deputy national security advisor Anne Neuberger is watching for signs of competition and cooperation on artificial intelligence at President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping's summit this week.

diplomatic_visits.title: Protection for women who defy the Mafia is changing in Italy. Does it go far enough?
diplomatic_visits.description: For women speaking out against the Mafia, the protection offered can be both practically and emotionally challenging. A new Italian law extending protection from organized crime to children and the adults caring for them — often their mothers — is designed to address some of that gap.

diplomatic_visits.title: Why Prince Harry and Meghan face more challenges after their return to the U.K.
diplomatic_visits.description: Issues that arose when Prince Harry and Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, stepped back from official duties in 2020, along with new challenges around concerns such as security, are front and centre after their return to Britain.

diplomatic_visits.title: Macron and Carney to hold talks on strengthening Canada-France economic and defense ties
diplomatic_visits.description: French President Emmanuel Macron and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney are set to meet to deepen economic and security ties on the North Atlantic archipelago of Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon

diplomatic_visits.title: Charles Spencer on the royal fallout following Princess Diana's death
diplomatic_visits.description: In his first interview about his new book, "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister," Charles Spencer talks about his attempt to set down what he calls the definitive story of Princess Diana.

elections.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
elections.description: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

elections.title: Germany's Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat
elections.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has faced a major electoral setback in two state elections, with his center-right party losing ground. The far-right Alternative for Germany party made significant gains.

elections.title: Russia holds parliamentary vote in areas it seized from Ukraine in the war
elections.description: Russia's parliamentary election for the first time is being held in Ukraine's regions that Moscow illegally annexed after the start of its full-scale invasion more than 4 1/2 years ago.

elections.title: Putin's ruling party on track to comfortably win wartime Russian election
elections.description: Russia's ruling United Russia party was on track to easily win a parliamentary election that President Vladimir Putin has cast as a test of support for the war in Ukraine, partial official results showed on Sunday, after Ukraine launched a massive ‌drone attack on the Russian capital.

elections.title: Germany's Merz vows to press on with reforms despite state election losses to far-right AfD
elections.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz suffered a bruising electoral setback in two state elections on Sunday, including a historic defeat for his party, but vowed to press ahead with potentially painful reforms to Europe's biggest economy.

global_events.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
global_events.summary: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

global_events.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
global_events.summary: Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.

global_events.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
global_events.summary: The singer spoke about Israel and Gaza after Macklemore was dropped from his tour for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

global_events.title: Trump says triumphal arch will be military complex with drones and snipers
global_events.summary: Trump said the updated plans were at the request of the US military and for national security purposes.

global_events.title: Man, 82, dies after beach fight with 76-year-old over sunlounger in Greece
global_events.summary: One eyewitness said the scene was so chaotic that screaming could be heard from the other end of the beach.
